logp.method_description: The partition coefficient of Ru3 was determined through the shake-flask method.2 To prepare water-saturated octanol, 4 ml of octanol was mixed with 1 ml of water and leftfor 24 h. Similarly, octanol-saturated water was prepared using the same procedure.The complex was then solubilized in 2 mL of saturated octanol by adding a minimal volume of DMSO, and this solution was added to 2 mL of saturated water. The resulting mixture underwent 24 h of shaking using a mechanical shaker, followed by settling and separation. The concentration of the complex was subsequently assessed through UV-vis absorption spectroscopy. Partition coefficient was calculated by thefollowing equation, logPo/w= log([complex]octanol/[complex]water)
